title: Phrase desk
scenario: V12. Compare input routes, preview and replace a response curve, reopen the panel and recover the mapping while preserving the score.
host: macOS 27.2.1 arm64, headless Chrome 158.0.8127.37, 1120 × 840 CSS pixels
backend: Moxi Python reference SVG, loopback server at 127.0.0.1:18182
fixture: First eight observations of examples/data/workbench-tail.csv, fresh local browser profile
reproduce: From the repository root, run PYTHONPATH=python python3 examples/personal-instrument/app.py --port 18182. In another shell with playwright-core resolvable, run PORT=18182 node examples/personal-instrument/check.cjs /tmp/phrase-desk-captures.

slides.caption: Linear accent mapping
slides.action: Open the instrument in a fresh profile.
slides.expected: Eight pitches appear. Step 1 is selected, with stored accent 70 and length 80. Half input maps to 50% accent.

slides.caption: Compare the draft with the active control
slides.action: Apply to step 1 by button. Focus the keyboard pad, advance and apply to step 2. Choose Length and 25% midpoint.
slides.expected: Both steps have accent 50. The active target is accent 50% and the draft is length 25%.

slides.caption: Perform with the reopened mapping
slides.action: Save mapping, reload, focus the pad and press Space.
slides.expected: Step 1 retains accent 50 and receives length 25. Step 2 retains its prior edit.

slides.caption: Recover the control while keeping the music
slides.action: Replace only the saved mapping with the future-version fixture in check.cjs and reload.
slides.expected: An unreadable-mapping message appears, linear accent is active and step 1 still has accent 50 and length 25.
